targets.expr:
(
    sum(increase((max without(instance, pod) (hass_sensor_energy_kwh{entity="sensor.shellyem_main_channel_1_energy"}))[$__range:1m])) - sum(increase((max without(instance, pod) (hass_sensor_energy_kwh{entity="sensor.shellyem_main_channel_2_energy"}))[$__range:1m]))
    + (sum(increase((max without(instance, pod) (hass_sensor_energy_kwh{entity="sensor.venus_total_discharging_energy"}))[$__range:1m])) or vector(0))
    - (sum(increase((max without(instance, pod) (hass_sensor_energy_kwh{entity="sensor.venus_total_charging_energy"}))[$__range:1m])) or vector(0))
)

targets.expr:
sum_over_time((
    (
        (sum(increase((max without(instance, pod) (hass_sensor_energy_kwh{entity="sensor.venus_total_discharging_energy"}))[1h:1m])) or vector(0))
        - (sum(increase((max without(instance, pod) (hass_sensor_energy_kwh{entity="sensor.venus_total_charging_energy"}))[1h:1m])) or vector(0))
    )
    * scalar(sum(sum_over_time(hass_sensor_unit_u0x20ac_per_kwh{entity="sensor.esios_pvpc"}[1h])) / sum(count_over_time(hass_sensor_unit_u0x20ac_per_kwh{entity="sensor.esios_pvpc"}[1h])))
)[$__range:1h])
